provenance.notes: bias_sigma = median over 26 sites of the 95% horizontal error (2.710 m) / 2.4477 (circular Gaussian), rounded to 0.1 mm; site range 0.670 to 3.240 m. It is the ABSOLUTE error of one standalone receiver; the model applies it independently per drone, so it stands in for a RELATIVE error that no retrieved source gives. All values therefore stay assumed. degraded_fraction 0.25 is the scenario value of docs/SENSITIVITY.md; the other values are the StressConfig defaults (docs/METHODS.md section 5).
